measurements.name: Bowl
measurements.limitations: 28/28 source-scene active snapshots and all result PPU rows match; exact 45-second scoring frame-phase and guest instruction timing not adjudicated.

conclusion: Two independent event families exhibit native scene-relative result onset one frame earlier. Their absolute host frame offsets differ, but for both event pairs terminal shift minus entry shift equals -1. The observation alone cannot resolve a host-calibrated scene entry boundary from CPU/NMI/VBlank guest execution timing.
explicit_non_conclusions: Not evidence of native physics/scoring failure
Not proof guest executes one instruction or one simulated frame early
Not proof one universal controller input rebase (Zoo +/-1 fails real lap progression)
